blockers.message: Its image is 2022-datacenter-azure-edition. AWS Application Migration Service refuses an Azure Edition Windows Server image: it carries Azure-specific platform integration (Hotpatch, SMB over QUIC, Azure Extended Networking) and must be re-imaged to a standard Windows Server edition before replication can start. This is not a licensing choice. It is a prerequisite.

_what_this_is: GOLDEN — the COMPLETING clarify branch, from capability run 5 (fresh isolated agent, answer keys prohibited, pointed only at SKILL.md). Its sibling after-clarify/ is the BLOCKED branch, kept deliberately: the scripted user there declines to state Azure spend, which proves ESSENTIAL + value:null gates the phase. This branch answers it, which is what makes design reachable. The only edit to the run's output was renaming `note`/`mapped_from` to `source` on DETECTED rows — a mechanical key rename, because the run's CONTENT was correct and only the key name was unspecified at the time. schema-preferences.md now names it.
_source_added_note: `source` was added to 5 cluster pattern_id rows after the run. The content is mechanically determined: 13.3c fixes catalog_absent's meaning and patterns.md's absence is a fact on disk, so there is exactly one possible reason. The run omitted it because schema-preferences.md did not require `source` on a DETECTED row until after the run started.
